newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil hailstorm kills three, destroys 40 homes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil hailstorm kills three, destroys 40 homes.

text.p: Three children were crushed to death by collapsing walls when a violent hailstorm ravaged a town in the northeastern Brazilian state of Bahia, a civil defence spokesman said on Tuesday.

The storm injured 25 others and destroyed at least 40 homes as it pelted the town of Utinga, some 280 miles (450 kms) west of the state capital Salvador, for an hour and a half on Monday night, he told Reuters.
An 18-month-old baby, a two-year-old infant and a 15-year-old child were killed, the spokesman said.
The hail was accompanied by high winds, which uprooted trees and downed telephone and power lines, he added.
Civil defence officials have sent blankets, tents and food to aid residents of Utinga, a town of 25,000 people.
